sara_cs: Quick sync 10 AM PT cutover for Novae StablePool. Need final quota, autoscale guardrails, and load-test owner.

Tom_ops: I can own load tests. Need exact QPS targets and sample long-contexts.

sara_cs: Targets: baseline 320 rps, sustained peak 1.1k rps, short bursts to 2k rps (<=5m). Avg seq ~600 tokens. Cost cap for first 48h: $7k unless approved.

Tom_ops: Plan: ramp 0 -> 50% -> 100% over 20m, soak 15m, then 2x 5m bursts to 2k. Will capture p50/p95/p99, KV cache hitrate, batch sizes, GPU util.

nina_sre: Recommend reserved pool = 5 nodes for first 12h, canary 10% traffic for first 60m. Autoscale: step +2, cooldown 180s, max nodes 40. Set circuit-breaker: if p95 > 1.2s for 2 windows -> shift 25% to fallback model.

luis_devex: I'll draft a short runbook and rollback command, attach to CS-8200. Quick rollback example: `redwoodctl routing update --account novae --model gpt-small-8q --weight 1.0`.

sara_cs: I'll upload sanitized traces to gs://redwood-cs/novae/sanitized/ by EOD and confirm KMS scopes. Also will collect a 3-question feedback form for Novae engineers during the dry-run.

deploy-bot: Reserved pool allocation requested by @nina_sre for account 'StablePool'  ticket CS-8200

Tom_ops: I'll run shadow replay Tue 02:00 PT and post a short summary here (p50/p95/p99, kv_hitrate curve, any tokenizer diffs). If anything off, we hold cutover.

sara_cs: Thanks everyone 1 sync 08:30 PT day-of to greenlight.
